recommendation_summary: Right now the reply has new bookings go through one form-based save path. That path locks the item identifier, checks the requested dates against existing bookings for that item, rejects any overlap and only then writes and releases the lock. It names a script lock or a database exclusion constraint as ways to do this. The spreadsheet stays as the working list, and red formatting stays only as a visual cue for existing rows. Gaps: the reply has none of the four labelled record lines, and it doesn't fully say how direct cell edits will be stopped.
note: The choice is an atomic, lock-based conflict check that rejects the second of two simultaneous bookings, but the reply leaves out all four record labels.
